question.text: When was the Chicago Board of Trade (CBOT) established?

explanation.text: The Logic: The workbook states that the Chicago Board of Trade (CBOT) was launched in 1848 in the USA and lists it as part of the CME Group. The Trap: 1730 is associated with the Osaka Rice Exchange in Japan, 1877 with the London Metal Exchange and 1875 with the Bombay Cotton Trade Association. Note: The keyed answer relies only on the source-supported launch year and the CME Group affiliation; no further superlatives are added here.
